description: What is physically inside one Finnish postal area: public transport stops (bus, tram, metro, train, ferry) from Digitransit; daycare centres from the Suomi.fi service catalogue (PTV), with OpenStreetMap adding only those with no PTV daycare within 250 m; and schools, higher and further education, health clinics, pharmacies, supermarkets and libraries from OpenStreetMap; and swimming pools and beaches from LIPAS, the national register of sports facilities. Answers "what is there in Tikkurila?" or "is there a school in 99980?" with counts and names. With `withinKm` (up to 5) it also looks beyond the area: places within that straight-line distance of the area's boundary, nearest first per category with their distance — one call for "is there a pool or a beach near 00250?". Postal areas only; a city name returns its areas to choose from. Transit counts are platforms (most stops have one per direction); `names` groups platforms by stop name. A zero for an OpenStreetMap category means none is mapped there, not that none exists; a null count means that source has not been loaded; a null name is a place its source has no name for. This says nothing about travel times or service frequency. Free for everyone. Licensed per source: the OpenStreetMap places and the daycare layer are ODbL 1.0, the pools and beaches CC BY 4.0; credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors", Digitransit, the Suomi.fi service catalogue and "Jyväskylän yliopisto, Lipas Liikuntapaikat.fi" when reproducing it.

categories.description: Only these categories; defaults to all fourteen.

place.description: Postal area name or 5-digit code, e.g. "Tikkurila", "00530"

withinKm.description: Also look this many km beyond the area's boundary (straight-line, 0.1 to 5), and answer with the nearest places and their distance.

name: get_nearby_places
title: Transit stops and services inside a Finnish postal area, or within a few km of it
